en.headline: Customs seizes 13kg suspected ketamine at airport, Japanese man arrested
en.dek: Officers found the drugs, valued at about HK$4.7 million, in the checked luggage of a 22-year-old passenger arriving from Frankfurt on Sunday.
body: Hong Kong Customs seized about 13 kilograms of suspected ketamine with an estimated street value of HK$4.7 million at Hong Kong International Airport on Sunday and arrested a 22-year-old Japanese man.
The man arrived from Frankfurt. During customs clearance, officers discovered the suspected drugs inside his checked suitcase and detained him for investigation.

The Customs and Excise Department said the case is under investigation. It continues to step up enforcement against drug trafficking through intelligence analysis and reminded the public not to take part in trafficking activities for monetary reward.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲13公斤疑似氯胺酮 拘22歲日本籍男子
zh.dek: 周日一名由法蘭克福抵港乘客行李內發現市值約470萬元懷疑氯胺酮，男子已被捕。
body: 香港海關周日在香港國際機場檢獲約13公斤懷疑氯胺酮，估計市值470萬元，並拘捕一名22歲日本籍男子。
該名男子由法蘭克福抵港。過關檢查時，關員在其託運行李箱內發現懷疑毒品，隨即將他拘捕。
海關表示案件仍在調查中，並會繼續透過情報分析加強打擊販毒活動，同時提醒市民切勿為金錢報酬參與販毒。
